user.title: Add PID Controller Thermostat
user.description: Configure a virtual thermostat with custom PID control. The PI heating demand entity will be auto-detected from the real thermostat's device.

data_description.temperature_entity: Sensor or climate entity that provides the current room temperature.
data_description.real_thermostat_entity: The real Zigbee thermostat. Its PI heating demand entity will be auto-detected.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PID Controller Thermostat
reconfigure.description: Update the entities used by this virtual thermostat. The PI heating demand entity will be re-detected from the real thermostat's device.

data_description.temperature_entity: Sensor or climate entity that provides the current room temperature.
data_description.real_thermostat_entity: The real Zigbee thermostat. Its PI heating demand entity will be re-detected.

manual_demand.title: Select heating demand entity
manual_demand.description: No PI heating demand entity could be auto-detected on the thermostat's device. Pick the number entity (0-100 %) that controls the valve opening.

error.already_configured: This thermostat is already controlled by another PID Controller entry.

data.sync_target_temperature: Sync target temperature to real thermostat

data_description.kd: Braking on temperature slope, in % valve per °C/hour of change. Acts on the measured temperature (no setpoint kick) and is low-pass filtered.
data_description.floor_value: Minimum valve opening percentage when heating is needed. Prevents the valve from closing completely.
data_description.off_threshold: Degrees above target temperature before the valve fully closes to 0%.
data_description.update_interval: How often to re-send the valve position to prevent the built-in PID from taking over.
data_description.pid_sample_interval: How often the PID algorithm recalculates the valve position. Writes are only sent when the value changes.
data_description.boost_threshold: When the room is this many degrees below target, the valve opens to the boost value for fast warmup. Set to 0 to disable boost.
data_description.boost_value: Valve opening percentage during boost mode.
data_description.sensor_stale_timeout: If the temperature source stops reporting for this long, valve control is paused so the thermostat's built-in controller can take over as a safe fallback. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.sync_target_temperature: When enabled, the target temperature is also sent to the real thermostat. Keeps its display correct and makes the built-in PID a safer fallback.
